included: Every regular file in the completed extracted test tree
Decode, dimensions, JPEG metadata, SHA-256, 64-bit DCT pHash, filename patterns, and manual visual samples
excluded: The incomplete train.zip.part archive and all of its content
Admission to any prepared manifest or model run

tree_inventory.digest_algorithm: sha256(sorted utf8 relative_posix_path + NUL + decimal_byte_size + NUL + lowercase_file_sha256 + LF), v1

publisher_claim_alignment.inference: The exact count match and absence of augmentation-style filenames support treating TEST as the provider's original-candidate collection, but duplicates, recompression, Photoshop metadata, standardized dimensions, and stripped EXIF prevent certifying it as untouched raw-camera originals.

resolution_profile.interpretation: The strong resolution cohorts indicate standardized export or resize pipelines and must not be mistaken for independent camera provenance.

metadata_profile.privacy_note: Derived training assets must not retain unnecessary GPS, artist, or camera metadata. Raw-source attribution and licence evidence must remain separately auditable.

filename_profile.interpretation: Per-class counters and mixed renamed/raw-camera patterns do not preserve reliable original-to-derivative or capture-session lineage.

duplicate_analysis.method_note: pHash matches are candidate visual-dependence links, not proof of identical pixels or identical labels. Counts use transitive connected components at Hamming distance <= 4.

findings: The corpus mixes in-field and canopy images with handheld and detached leaves on white paper, rugs, concrete, black tire-like material, and tree stumps.
Sequential files frequently show the same leaf or plant with small viewpoint changes; Corn Normal leaf/109.jpg through 112.jpg are a clear capture-burst example rather than four independent plants.

Other repeated-session examples include Apple Brown_spot/1.jpg through 3.jpg, Walnut Blotch_leaf disease/1.jpg and 2.jpg, tomato Fusarium Wilt/1.JPG and 2.JPG, and Corn gray leaf spot/1.jpg and 2.jpg.
No visible watermark or text overlay was observed in the manual sample, but no corpus-wide absence claim is made.
Several broad folder labels and sampled maize presentations require agronomist adjudication before canonical disease mapping.

decision_rationale: The test tree count is consistent with the publisher's collected-image count, but original-to-derivative lineage cannot be established until the separate training archive is complete and audited.
Exact byte-identical images occur under contradictory class labels.
Capture bursts, recompressed repetitions, and pHash-connected components violate an independent-image assumption.
Provider folder names and the provider test boundary are not sufficient evidence for canonical labels or an independent evaluation split.
Pakistan regional imagery can improve development diversity but cannot substitute for locked, independently labelled Nepal evidence.
potential_future_role: Training-only or development-diagnostic public data after every remediation item passes
required_remediation: Wait for train.zip to complete; verify archive checksums, archive integrity, licence evidence, and exact provider version without reading a partial archive.
Build cross-archive lineage using exact hashes, pHash, and geometric or photometric derivative matching. Exclude augmented derivatives or bind every derivative to its original's train-only group.
Quarantine every whole mixed-label exact or near-duplicate component. Require agronomist adjudication before restoring any member.

Group same-leaf, same-plant, and capture-burst sequences before split assignment using pHash, sequential-name evidence, dimensions, backgrounds, and manual review; filename adjacency alone is insufficient.
Discard the provider train/test boundary and create any development split only after grouping. Never present this inspected public source as a pristine external holdout.
Map only reviewed maize and tomato labels into canonical KrishiDoc keys. Treat vague or unsupported conditions as explicit unknown; map all other crop species only as wrong-crop or OOD evidence.
Perform a representative agronomist label audit, with heightened review of maize gray/fungal/holcus folders and tomato Verticillium/late-blight conflicts.
Complete a corpus-wide rights, watermark, and privacy review. Strip unnecessary EXIF/GPS from derived model inputs without losing source attribution records.
Re-run the fail-closed manifest audit and record a new immutable manifest hash before any experiment starts.
